title: Four Winds Molokini Maui Snorkel Tour

services.name: Snorkel Maui
services.desc: We provide you with the snorkeling trip of a lifetime to some of Maui’s premier snorkeling destinations like Molokini Crater and Coral Gardens. Join us for the best Maui snorkel tour. Molokini Crater is a partially submerged, crescent-shaped volcanic crater located about 2.5 miles (4 km) off the southwestern coast of Maui. It is one of the top snorkeling destinations in Hawaii due to its crystal-clear waters, diverse marine life, and unique geological features. Here’s why it’s such a sought-after spot: Maui Snorkeling With more accessible beaches than any other Hawaiian island, it’s truly no surprise why Maui is the go-to destination of millions interested in water sports. services.desc: We highly recommend making your reservation in advance, due to the boat being at full capacity during summer months (high season). This Maui Molokini Crater Whale Watch & Snorkel Tour dedicates time to and from your snorkel destination so that you can search for whales in the wild. Observe them in their natural habitat on Maui! See the humpback whales up close AND visit Maui’s top-rated snorkel destinations. The Four Winds morning snorkel tour to Molokini Crater gives you Maui’s best snorkeling value and experience. services.desc: Step aboard the Four Winds to experience Maui’s brand-new glass-bottom viewing room! You’ll love this totally immersive way to explore the ocean while staying dry! This unique space invites everyone, from kids to adults, to comfortably enjoy the vibrant marine life of Maui. The glass-bottom boat is perfect for everyone! Those who may feel unsure about snorkeling or are curious about what lies beneath can simply sit back, relax, and observe from the comfort and safety of this unique viewing room. quotes.author: Reviewed by joyovelardeRating: 5
quotes.text: This experience, to me, is what connecting with your family on vacation should be – adventurous, inspiring, and authentically local. Mahalo to the Four Winds Crew for their hospitality and spirit of Aloha. We hope to do it again in the future!

quotes.author: Samantha R. Flushing NY
quotes.text: This was a great snorkeling experience! The boat was spacious with ample seating options. Best part is we were free to enjoy at our own pace. There was no tour guide shuffling us around from one spot to the next. The boat was clean and well maintained. There were lots of activities for younger ones. Best part of the trip was how many whales we saw! Highly recommend this snorkeling experience.

quotes.author: Mealnie X.
quotes.text: Started out the trip whale watching and we got the chance to see about 4 to 5 pods of whales! It was truly a breathtaking experience to see whales in their natural habitats. We did snorkeling at the coral garden which was just as stunning.

quotes.author: Janelle P. San Lorenzo CA
quotes.text: We snorkeled Coral gardens it was very calm and beautiful. We snorkeled for quite some time saw so many fish, and a SEA TURTLE, I literally swam side by side him! I loved every minute of this trip!

quotes.author: Nathaniel P. Seattle WA
quotes.text: This is my 2nd trip with the crew of Four Winds Snorkeling. Still a great experience. I recommend these guys to everyone I know!
